rules.name: SI Unit Standardisation
rules.description: Verify that SI units and their symbols follow the applicable international conventions and publisher requirements.
options: Replace the non-SI unit name or symbol with the SI form (sec → s; hr → h)
Keep the author's unit and add the SI equivalent in parentheses
rules.notes: Unit names and symbols only. Converting a value is rule 28.

rules.name: Unit Symbol Formatting
rules.description: Check the correct representation of unit symbols, such as kg, m, s, and mol, including capitalisation and symbol integrity.
options: Correct the symbol's case and form (KG → kg; Mol → mol; l → L)
Replace a look-alike character with the correct symbol (µ, °)

rules.name: Space Between Numbers and Units
rules.description: Verify that a space separates a numerical value from a unit symbol, such as 25 kg and 37 °C, except where specific conventions apply.
options: Keep closed form where the style requires it (25%)

rules.name: Unit Abbreviation Consistency
rules.description: Standardise unit abbreviations throughout the manuscript according to the applicable style guide and subject-specific requirements.
options: Use the abbreviation set in the style profile throughout (h, min, s)
Use the form that dominates in the manuscript

rules.name: Temperature Formatting
rules.description: Check the formatting of temperature values and symbols, such as 25 °C, according to the required scientific style.

rules.name: Percentage Formatting
rules.description: Standardise percentage presentation, such as 25% or 25 %, according to the applicable style guide.

rules.name: Mathematical Symbol Consistency
rules.description: Verify the correct and consistent use of mathematical symbols, operators, inequalities, and comparison signs.
options: Replace look-alikes with the correct operator (− for hyphen, × for x, ≤ ≥ for <= >=)
Use the form the author uses most consistently

rules.name: Greek Letter Consistency
rules.description: Check the correct use of Greek letters, such as α, β, and μ, in scientific and medical terminology.
options: Use the Unicode Greek letter (α, β, μ)
Spell out in running text where the style requires (alpha, beta)

rules.name: Micro Prefix Standardisation
rules.description: Verify the correct use of the micro symbol (μ) in unit symbols and ensure compliance with the publisher's preferred terminology, such as mcg where required for medication dosages.
options: Use mcg for medication dosages where the publisher requires it
rules.notes: Apply mcg only to medication dosages and only where the publisher requires it.

rules.name: Superscript and Subscript Formatting
rules.description: Verify that exponents, chemical formulas, mathematical expressions, and scientific notation use appropriate superscript and subscript formatting.
options: Replace typed ^ or _ notation with formatted super/subscript

rules.name: Number Formatting
rules.description: Standardise numerical presentation, including thousands separators and decimal separators, according to the target language and publisher requirements.
options: Use a thin space as thousands separator (1 000)
Keep four-digit numbers closed (1000) where the style allows
rules.notes: A separator change can alter a value (1.000 vs 1,000): check the language variant first.

rules.name: Decimal Precision
rules.description: Check whether decimal places and significant figures are presented consistently and flag unexplained inconsistencies without changing scientific values.
options: Query author to confirm the precision (no change to the value)
Apply a uniform number of decimal places only after the author confirms
rules.notes: Scientific values are never changed automatically.

rules.name: Number Style
rules.description: Apply the specified rules for spelling out numbers versus using numerals, considering the style guide and disciplinary conventions.
options: Spell out one to nine; numerals for 10 and above
Numerals for all measurements and quantities (5 mg; 3 days)
Spell out a number that begins a sentence

rules.name: Number Range Formatting
rules.description: Standardise number ranges, such as 10–15, pp. 25–30, or other prescribed forms.

rules.name: Negative Number Formatting
rules.description: Verify the consistent representation of negative values using the correct minus sign rather than an inappropriate hyphen.

rules.name: Fractions and Ratios
rules.description: Check consistent formatting of fractions, ratios, proportions, and related numerical expressions.
options: Use the style's form (1/2 or ½; 3:1)

rules.name: Date Format Standardisation
rules.description: Standardise dates according to the required format, such as October 10, 2026 for US English or 10 October 2026 for UK English.

rules.name: Date Consistency
rules.description: Check that dates are consistently formatted throughout the manuscript, including running text, tables, figures, notes, and appendices.
options: Apply the required date format everywhere (text, tables, figures, notes)
Convert only dates in tables and figures to match the text
rules.notes: Handling is entered as 'Review Auto Fix' in the checklist; treated here as auto-correct followed by editor review. Confirm.

rules.name: Time Format Standardisation
rules.description: Standardise time presentation, including 12-hour or 24-hour notation, according to the specified style.

rules.name: Time Zone Formatting
rules.description: Check the consistent presentation of time zones and their abbreviations where relevant.
options: Use the standard abbreviation, defined at first use (UTC, EST)
Spell out the zone (Eastern Standard Time)

rules.name: Currency Formatting
rules.description: Standardise currency symbols, currency codes, numerical values, and their placement according to the target market and style guide.
options: Symbol before the amount, no space ($5 million; £50)
ISO code before the amount (USD 5 million)

rules.name: Mathematical Equation Formatting
rules.description: Check the structural presentation of equations, including alignment, numbering, symbols, and references within the text.
options: Align and number equations consecutively; cite as Equation (1)
Convert a simple display equation to inline text (a + b = c)
Query author (equation unclear or supplied as an image)

rules.name: Chemical Formula Formatting
rules.description: Verify the presentation of chemical formulas, including element symbols, subscripts, superscripts, and charge notation.

rules.name: Scientific Notation
rules.description: Check the consistent formatting of values expressed in scientific notation, including exponents and powers of ten.
options: Use E notation in tables and data only (3.2E5)
Replace the letter x with the multiplication sign ×

rules.name: Statistical Notation
rules.description: Verify the formatting of statistical symbols, variables, probability values, confidence intervals, and related expressions against the relevant style guide.
options: Italicise statistical symbols (p, n, t, F)
Write p-values per style (p < 0.001 or P < .001)

rules.name: Statistical Value Consistency
rules.description: Flag inconsistencies between statistical values reported in the text, tables, figures, and supplementary material.
options: Query author: values differ between text and table or figure
Update the text to match the table (only if the author confirms)
Update the table to match the text (only if the author confirms)
rules.notes: Scientific values are never changed automatically.

rules.name: Measurement Consistency
rules.description: Verify that the same measurement units and conventions are used consistently within comparable contexts.
options: Use one unit consistently within comparable contexts (mg throughout)
Add the second unit in parentheses where both are needed

rules.name: Unit Conversion Verification
rules.description: Flag potentially inconsistent conversions between measurement systems for editorial or subject-matter review without automatically changing values.
options: Query author or subject expert to verify the conversion
Add or correct the converted value only after author confirmation
rules.notes: Scientific values are never changed automatically. Rule wording is flag only.

rules.name: Range and Tolerance Formatting
rules.description: Standardise the presentation of measurement ranges, tolerances, and uncertainty values according to the applicable technical style.
options: Use an en dash for ranges (5–10 mm)

rules.name: Degree Symbol Formatting
rules.description: Verify the correct use of degree symbols in temperatures, angles, and geographical coordinates.
options: Use the degree sign ° (not º or a superscript o) with correct spacing

rules.name: First-Use Abbreviation Definition
rules.description: Check that abbreviations are expanded at first use where required by the publisher's style guide.
options: Expand at first use with the abbreviation in parentheses (World Health Organization [WHO])
Define in the abbreviation list only
Spell out in full (do not abbreviate)

rules.name: Abbreviation Reuse
rules.description: Verify that established abbreviations are used consistently after their definitions have been introduced.
options: Use the abbreviation after its definition
Re-define in the abstract and again in the main text if the style requires

rules.name: Abbreviation List Validation
rules.description: Compare abbreviations used in the manuscript against the abbreviation list and flag missing, unused, or inconsistent entries.
options: Add the missing abbreviation to the list
Delete the unused entry from the list

rules.name: Acronym Capitalisation
rules.description: Check the capitalisation of acronyms and initialisms according to established usage and house style.
options: Use lower case for acronyms that have become words (laser, scuba)

rules.name: Latin Abbreviation Formatting
rules.description: Verify the presentation of Latin abbreviations such as et al., i.e., and e.g. according to the specified style.
options: e.g., & vs. (roman with comma, US standard)
e.g. & vs (roman without comma, UK standard)
for example, & versus (spelled out in English)

rules.name: Scientific Name Formatting
rules.description: Check the formatting of genus and species names, including italicisation and capitalisation conventions.
options: Italicise genus and species; capitalise the genus only (Homo sapiens)
Abbreviate the genus after first use (H. sapiens)

rules.name: Taxonomic Name Consistency
rules.description: Verify consistent use of organism names and taxonomic terminology throughout the manuscript.
options: Give the common name with the scientific name at first use

rules.name: Gene and Protein Nomenclature
rules.description: Flag gene and protein names for compliance with the relevant subject-specific nomenclature conventions.
options: Apply the species convention (gene symbols italic, protein symbols roman)
Correct the symbol to the approved database form

rules.name: Drug Name Consistency
rules.description: Check consistent presentation of generic and brand-name drug names according to the applicable medical style and regulatory requirements.
options: Use the generic name in lower case (ibuprofen)
Capitalise the brand name, with the generic name at first use (Advil [ibuprofen])

rules.name: Medical Terminology
rules.description: Verify the spelling and consistency of medical terms against the publisher's approved medical dictionary or terminology reference.
options: Correct to the approved medical dictionary spelling
Use the preferred term from the publisher's terminology reference

rules.name: Anatomical Terminology
rules.description: Check the spelling and consistent presentation of anatomical terms according to the required nomenclature.
options: Use the standard anatomical term in lower case (for example Terminologia Anatomica)
Use the common English term, with the anatomical term at first use

rules.name: Chemical Terminology
rules.description: Check chemical names, symbols, and terminology for consistency with the applicable scientific conventions.
options: Use the IUPAC name or the accepted common name consistently
Correct the spelling of the name or symbol

rules.name: Trademark and Registered Symbols
rules.description: Verify the consistent treatment of trademarks, registered marks, and proprietary names according to publisher requirements.
options: Keep the symbol at first mention only

rules.name: Copyright Symbols
rules.description: Check the formatting and placement of copyright symbols and associated notices where required.

rules.name: Special Character Validation
rules.description: Identify missing, corrupted, substituted, or incorrectly encoded special characters in the manuscript.
options: Replace the corrupted character with the correct Unicode character
Insert the missing character from the source file
rules.notes: Rule wording is detect only. Replace only when the intended character is certain.

rules.name: Trademarked Product Names
rules.description: Verify the spelling and capitalisation of proprietary product names against approved references where available.
options: Correct spelling and capitalisation to the approved form (iPhone; PowerPoint)

rules.name: Terminology Database Validation
rules.description: Compare selected technical terms against an approved glossary or terminology database to identify inconsistencies.
options: Replace with the approved glossary term
Keep (term not in the glossary; add it to the glossary)

rules.name: Footnote and Endnote References
rules.group: Completeness, order, duplicates and style compliance
rules.description: Check note numbering, citation placement, and consistency between notes and their corresponding references.
options: Move the note callout after the punctuation
Query author (note and reference do not match)

rules.name: Heading Hierarchy
rules.description: Verify that headings and subheadings follow a logical and consistent hierarchy throughout the manuscript.
options: Restore a logical heading-level order (no skipped levels)
Promote or demote the heading to the correct level

rules.name: Heading Numbering
rules.description: Check the sequence and consistency of numbered headings and subheadings.
options: Remove numbering if the style does not number headings

rules.name: Heading Capitalisation
rules.description: Standardise heading capitalisation according to the publisher's style guide.
options: Follow the publisher's style (set in the style profile)

rules.name: Table Numbering
rules.description: Verify the sequence and consistency of table numbers throughout the manuscript.
options: Renumber tables consecutively and update the callouts
Use the numeral type the style requires (Arabic or Roman)

rules.name: Figure Numbering
rules.description: Verify the sequence and consistency of figure numbers throughout the manuscript.
options: Renumber figures consecutively and update the callouts
Use the numeral type the style requires (Arabic or Roman)

rules.name: Table Callout Validation
rules.description: Check that every table cited in the text exists and that table callouts follow the required sequence.
options: Add the missing table callout in the text

rules.name: Figure Callout Validation
rules.description: Check that every figure cited in the text exists and that figure callouts follow the required sequence.
options: Add the missing figure callout in the text

rules.name: Table Caption Consistency
rules.description: Verify the formatting, numbering, and wording of table titles and captions according to the publisher's style.
options: Apply the publisher's table title format (label, number, title)
Move the caption above the table

rules.name: Figure Caption Consistency
rules.description: Check the formatting, numbering, and completeness of figure captions and legends.
options: Apply the publisher's figure caption format (label, number, legend)
Move the caption below the figure

rules.name: Caption–Asset Matching
rules.description: Verify that captions correspond to the correct tables, figures, images, and other visual assets.
options: Correct the caption number or text to match the asset
Swap the captions between the assets

rules.name: Table Footnotes
rules.description: Check the formatting, sequence, and placement of table footnotes and explanatory notes.
options: Use the style's markers in order (a, b, c or *, †)
Move the footnotes below the table

rules.name: Figure Legend Validation
rules.description: Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent figure legends and explanatory keys.
options: Query author for the missing legend or key
Complete the legend from the text

rules.name: Table Structure
rules.description: Check the consistency of table rows, columns, headers, and data alignment.
options: Align rows and columns and repair merged cells

rules.name: Table Abbreviation Definitions
rules.description: Verify that abbreviations used in tables are defined according to the required style.
options: Define the abbreviations in a table footnote

rules.name: Table Unit Consistency
rules.description: Check that units of measurement are consistently represented in table headings, cells, and notes.
options: Put the unit in the column heading and remove it from the cells
Add the missing unit to the heading

rules.name: Missing Content Detection
rules.description: Identify apparent gaps, incomplete sections, missing paragraphs, or unexpected interruptions in the manuscript.
options: Query author: text appears to be missing
Insert the missing text if supplied separately

rules.name: Duplicate Content Detection
rules.description: Identify repeated paragraphs, duplicated sections, or potentially redundant content for editorial review.
options: Delete the duplicated passage (after editor review)

rules.name: Contradictory Statements
rules.description: Flag statements that appear inconsistent with other information presented elsewhere in the manuscript.
options: Query author to resolve the contradiction
Edit one statement to match the other (author-confirmed)

rules.name: Terminology Conflicts
rules.description: Identify instances where the same concept is described using inconsistent or potentially conflicting terminology.
options: Define both terms if they differ in meaning

rules.name: Internal Consistency Check
rules.description: Compare repeated facts, names, dates, quantities, and terminology across chapters or sections.
options: Make repeated facts, names, dates and quantities agree (once confirmed)

rules.name: Author Query Identification
rules.description: Identify unresolved questions, placeholders, incomplete statements, and ambiguous content that require author clarification.
options: Insert an author query at the passage

rules.name: Placeholder Detection
rules.description: Identify temporary text such as TK, TBD, insert figure, or reference needed that may remain in the manuscript.
options: Query author to supply the missing text (TK, TBD)

rules.name: Content Completeness
rules.description: Check whether all expected manuscript components have been supplied according to the project specifications.
options: Query author for the missing component
Add the component from the project files
Record as outstanding (not required for this project)

rules.name: Editorial Readiness Assessment
rules.description: Generate a summary of identified issues and outstanding queries to determine whether the manuscript is ready for copyediting or production.
options: Hold: return to author before copyediting
